text: === FILE src/payee/types.ts === ⏎ export interface DecodedFrame { ⏎ seq: number; ⏎ ts: string; ⏎ frame: import("@flop-labs/tclk").TclkFrame; ⏎ verified: boolean; ⏎ } ⏎ === FILE src/payee/open-offers.ts === ⏎ import { validateDeadlines, type AcceptFrame, type OfferFrame } from "@flop-labs/tclk"; ⏎ import type { DecodedFrame } from "./types.js"; ⏎ export interface OpenPayerOffersOptions { ⏎ selfDid?: string; ⏎ rails?: string[]; ⏎ minClaimMs?: number; ⏎ minGapMs?: number; ⏎ ignoreAccepts?: Set<string>; ⏎ allowAccepted?: (payer: string) => boolean; ⏎ lockedOffers?: Set<string>; ⏎ } ⏎ export function openPayerOffers( ⏎ frames: DecodedFrame[], ⏎ nowMs: number, ⏎ opts: OpenPayerOffersOptions = {}, ⏎ ): DecodedFrame[] { ⏎ const { ⏎ selfDid, ⏎ rails = ["paper"], ⏎ minClaimMs = 5 * 60_000, ⏎ minGapMs = 60_000, ⏎ ignoreAccepts = new Set<string>(), ⏎ allowAccepted, ⏎ lockedOffers = new Set<string>(), ⏎ } = opts; ⏎ const acceptedOffers = new Map<string, Set<string>>(); ⏎ for (const df of frames) { ⏎ if (df.frame.type === "accept") { ⏎ const acc = df.frame as AcceptFrame; ⏎ if (!acceptedOffers.has(acc.offerId)) { ⏎ acceptedOffers.set(acc.offerId, new Set()); ⏎ } ⏎ acceptedOffers.get(acc.offerId)!.add(acc.from); ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ return frames.filter((df) => { ⏎ if (!df.verified) return false; ⏎ if (df.frame.type !== "offer") return false; ⏎ const offer = df.frame as OfferFrame; ⏎ if (offer.role !== "payer") return false; ⏎ if (!offer.lock) return false; ⏎ if (selfDid && offer.from === selfDid) return false; ⏎ if (offer.expiresMs <= nowMs) return false; ⏎ const hasSharedRail = rails.some((r) => offer.rails.includes(r)); ⏎ if (!hasSharedRail) return false; ⏎ if (!validateDeadlines(offer, nowMs, minClaimMs, minGapMs)) return false; ⏎ if (lockedOffers.has(offer.id)) return false; ⏎ const acceptors = acceptedOffers.get(offer.id); ⏎ if (acceptors) { ⏎ const hasBlockingAccept = Array.from(acceptors).some( ⏎ (acceptor) => !ignoreAccepts.has(acceptor), ⏎ ); ⏎ if (hasBlockingAccept) { ⏎ if (!allowAccepted || !allowAccepted(offer.from)) { ⏎ return false; ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ return true; ⏎ }); ⏎ }
